name: Noir Mystery: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the Noir Mystery look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, film noir still, hard chiaroscuro, venetian-blind shadows across the face, rain-slick streets, fedoras and trench coats, cigarette smoke, black and white or heavily desaturated, single hard key light, deep blacks, wet reflective surfaces
negative_prompt: bright saturated colour, sunny daylight, modern technology, cartoon, cheerful mood, text, watermark
